claim: Battle unit state reads as a cohesive portrait-led mobile combat HUD instead of a text-heavy HP/EN debug table.
artifact_or_command: Independent final review of project-a/artifacts/ui-battle-844x390.png and ui-battle-568x320.png

assertions: Independent critic scored the standard composition 8.5/10.
Health and charge semantics are readable; remaining thin empty charge state is non-blocking.
Independent critic scored compact presentation 8.0/10 with touch density retained.

observation: Independent critic PASS: overall 8.2, lowest dimension 7.5, confidence 96%.
inference: The visual gate passes after adding role badges, explicit charge icons and stronger card affordance.
limitations: Compact portraits remain visually similar and around 30px in the static capture.
